scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=@minhaobra/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@minhaobra/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@minhaobra/api && npm run build --workspace=@minhaobra/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@minhaobra/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@minhaobra/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@minhaobra/api && npm run lint --workspace=@minhaobra/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@minhaobra/api && npm run test --workspace=@minhaobra/web
